description: V0 Core App: Storage, Decks, Import, Review, Browse — Loudmouth PWA built with Vite and plain JS

tasks.title: Scaffold Vite + plain JS app with IndexedDB via Dexie.js
tasks.description: Set up the Vite project in app/, install Dexie.js, and create the entry point main.js that initializes the DB and wires up the router.
acceptanceCriteria: app/ directory contains a valid Vite project with package.json
Dexie.js is installed and imported in main.js
npm run dev starts the dev server without errors
index.html contains a single <div id="app"> container

tasks.title: Implement db.js data layer with Dexie schema and CRUD functions
tasks.description: As a learner, I want cards and decks to persist across sessions so that I don't lose my library when I close the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Dexie schema declares cards (indexed on lang, deckIds multiEntry) and decks (indexed on lang) tables
importCards(cards, deckId?) stores cards with correct deckIds including the All deck
getDecks(lang?) returns only decks for that language
getCards(deckId) returns only cards containing that deckId in their deckIds array
createDeck(name, lang) assigns a zero-padded counter + kebab slug ID
getOrCreateAllDeck(lang) creates the deck on first call and returns the existing one on subsequent calls
All deck (all-zh, all-ja) is excluded from getDecks results used for the import dropdown
Card IDs are UUID v4; createdAt is ISO 8601 shared across a batch

tasks.title: Implement import-parser.js pure validation function
tasks.description: As a learner, I want the import flow to show clear errors when the pasted JSON is malformed or missing required fields so that I know what went wrong and can fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: parseCardBatch(jsonString) returns { cards, errors }
Valid JSON with all required fields returns correct card array with no errors
Cards missing lang, front.text, or back.translation are skipped and reported in errors
Completely invalid JSON returns empty cards array with a parse error
Mix of valid and invalid cards returns valid subset with correct error count
Optional fields (reading, notes, example) absent causes no error
Function has no side effects and does not access IndexedDB

tasks.title: Implement tts.js Web Speech API wrapper
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to hear the front of a card spoken aloud in the correct language so that I can learn pronunciation without guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: speak(text, lang) fires a SpeechSynthesisUtterance with the correct lang attribute
cancel() stops any in-progress speech
ttsAvailable boolean is exported and reflects browser support at module load
speak() returns a promise or fires a callback on end/error so callers can update button state

tasks.title: Implement router.js hash-based screen switcher
tasks.description: Wire up hash-based navigation so that each screen renders into #app based on the URL fragment.
acceptanceCriteria: Listens to hashchange and initial load
Maps #home, #import, #review, #browse fragments to their render functions
Passes parsed query params (e.g. deckId) to each screen function
Navigating to an unknown hash falls back gracefully (e.g. redirects to #home)

tasks.title: Implement screen-home: language tabs, deck list, empty state
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to open the app and see my decks organized by language, and swipe left/right to switch between languages, so that I can quickly find what I want to review.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders language tab buttons (zh / ja) above the deck list
Active language tab shows only that language's decks
Swipe left/right (50px threshold, touch events, no library) switches active language tab
Empty state with import prompt is shown when no decks exist for the active language
Tapping the body of a deck card navigates to #review?deckId=…
Tapping the chevron on a deck card navigates to #browse?deckId=…

tasks.title: Implement screen-import: paste → parse → assign → save flow
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to paste a JSON card batch, see how many valid cards were parsed, confirm before importing, and optionally assign to a named deck so that I control what gets saved.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 1: textarea for pasting JSON
Step 2: shows count of valid cards parsed and any errors; requires confirmation before proceeding
Step 3: dropdown lists existing user-created decks plus a 'New deck…' option; All deck is auto-assigned and not shown in dropdown
Choosing 'New deck…' reveals a text input for the deck name
On confirm, cards are saved to DB and user is redirected to #home
Malformed JSON or missing required fields shows a clear inline error message

tasks.title: Implement screen-review: flip cards, prev/next, play audio, counter
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to flip through cards in random order, tap to flip, navigate prev/next, hear audio, and see my position in the deck.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards are presented in random order for the deck
Tapping the card flips it from front (target text + reading + type badge) to back (translation + notes + example)
Prev/next buttons navigate through the shuffled queue
Keyboard shortcuts work: ← prev, → next, Space/Enter flip, p play audio
Play button calls tts.speak() with the front text and correct language code
Counter shows current position (e.g. '3 / 12')
Card front shows type badge (word / phrase / sentence) and reading (pinyin / hiragana)
Card back shows example sentence, its reading, and translation when present; shows notes when present

tasks.title: Implement screen-browse: flat scrollable card list per deck
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to see all cards in a deck as a scrollable list showing front text and translation so that I can scan my vocabulary without entering review mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a scrollable list of all cards in the given deck
Each row shows the front text and the back translation
List is reachable via the chevron on a deck card on the home screen

tasks.title: Add per-screen CSS with design tokens from prototype
tasks.description: Carry the visual design language (color tokens, card flip animation, button styles) from prototypes/1-web-speech/index.html into the app's CSS files.
acceptanceCriteria: src/styles/ contains base.css, home.css, import.css, review.css, browse.css
Design tokens (colors, radii, typography) are defined as :root CSS variables in base.css
Card flip animation is present in review.css and matches the prototype visually
App is visually consistent with the prototype on iOS Safari

tasks.title: Configure PWA manifest and service worker for offline + installability
tasks.description: As a learner, I want the app to work offline after first load and be installable via Add to Home Screen on iOS Safari.
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.webmanifest declares display: standalone, correct icons, and lang metadata
Service worker (via vite-plugin-pwa or hand-written sw.js) caches the app shell
App loads and is functional with no network connection after first visit
iOS Safari shows Add to Home Screen prompt and launches without browser chrome when installed

tasks.title: Write Vitest tests for import-parser.js
tasks.description: Cover all validation cases for parseCardBatch so that regressions in the parser are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid JSON → correct card array, no errors
Missing lang → card skipped, error reported
Missing front.text → card skipped, error reported
Missing back.translation → card skipped, error reported
Completely invalid JSON → empty cards, parse error
Mix of valid and invalid → valid subset returned, error count correct
Optional fields absent → card returned without them, no error
All tests pass under vitest

tasks.title: Write Vitest tests for db.js using fake-indexeddb
tasks.description: Cover all DB contract cases so that data-layer regressions are caught without a real browser.
acceptanceCriteria: importCards with no secondary deck → cards stored with only All deck ID in deckIds
importCards with secondary deck → cards stored with both deck IDs
getOrCreateAllDeck('zh') called twice → only one all-zh deck exists
createDeck('Restaurant words', 'ja') → ID is 001-restaurant-words
createDeck called twice → second deck ID increments to 002-…
getCards(deckId) → returns only cards containing that deckId
getDecks('zh') → returns only zh decks, no ja decks
All deck excluded from getDecks results used for import dropdown
All tests pass under vitest with fake-indexeddb

tasks.title: Add card detail screen (#card?id=&deckId=)
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to tap a card row in browse and see all of its details so that I can read the full card without entering review mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping a row in #browse navigates to #card?id=…&deckId=…
Shows all card fields: front text, reading, type badge, translation, notes, example (text + reading + translation) — optional fields only shown when present
Back button returns to #browse?deckId=… for the originating deck
deckId param is preserved and passed correctly from browse so subsequent actions have context

tasks.title: Delete card or remove from deck via card detail screen
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to remove a card from a deck or permanently delete it from the All Cards view so that I can keep my decks tidy.
acceptanceCriteria: When deckId is a real deck: button reads 'Remove from deck'; on confirm calls removeCardFromDeck(cardId, deckId) and returns to #browse?deckId=…
When deckId is an All Cards virtual deck: button reads 'Delete card'; on confirm calls deleteCard(cardId) and returns to the All Cards browse view
Confirmation dialog is shown before any destructive action
db.js gains removeCardFromDeck(cardId, deckId) which removes that deckId from the card's deckIds array without deleting the card
db.js gains deleteCard(cardId) which permanently removes the card from IndexedDB

tasks.title: Delete deck from browse screen
tasks.description: As a learner, I want to delete a deck I no longer need so that my home screen stays organized.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button is visible on #browse?deckId=… for real decks
Delete button is hidden when the deckId corresponds to an All Cards virtual deck
Confirmation dialog is shown before deletion
On confirm, calls deleteDeck(deckId) (new db.js function) which removes only the deck record — cards are untouched
User is returned to #home after deletion
db.js gains deleteDeck(deckId)

tasks.title: Add import FAB to home screen
tasks.description: As a learner, I want a persistent import button on the home screen so that I can add cards at any time, not just when the deck list is empty.
acceptanceCriteria: A floating action button is visible on #home regardless of whether decks exist
Tapping the FAB navigates to #import
FAB does not obscure deck cards when scrolling

tasks.title: Make home screen language tabs data-driven
tasks.description: As a learner, I want the language tabs on the home screen to reflect the languages I actually have cards for so that the UI isn't cluttered with empty tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab list is derived from distinct lang values across all cards in the DB — no hardcoded zh/ja
A tab only appears when at least one card exists for that language
All Cards virtual deck is synthesized per language from all cards for that lang — no DB record required
All Cards virtual deck cannot be deleted (no delete button shown in browse for it)
